purpose: Exploratory only; no performance or threshold computed in Phase 5B.3A.
finalization_gates: Approve exploratory data reuse, identity assignment, and threshold objective.
A blind generalization claim needs a genuinely untouched approved dataset; all local cohorts have historical exposure.
Bind manifest and runtime profile hashes before future inference.

fold.ordering: Explicit identity slots; numeric image type then source path.
fold.optional_sensitivity: 13 cyclic rotations of sorted identities into 3 calibration-known, 3 calibration-unknown, 3 final-known, 4 final-unknown slots. Not run/finalized; repeated data are not independent.

source_identity_policy: IMM:NN is a provenance reference, preserving original labels/paths. Known/unknown is relative to each new gallery, not a relabeling of people.

manifest_schema.source_eligibility: Original readable JPEG RGB uint8 only; no ASF-PNG/fixture substitution.

future_pipeline.alignment: Approved MTCNN size160 alignTrue -> adapter -> FaceNet -> SQLite.
future_pipeline.gallery: Three fixed types1-3 per known identity. Abort primary fold if any enrollment fails; no replacements or silent gallery shrinkage.
future_pipeline.query_failure: 0 or >1 faces, failed alignment or invalid embedding => explicit failure, never credit as unknown rejection. Retain planned denominators.
future_pipeline.infrastructure_failure: Schema/version/model/IO errors abort fold, not recognition outcomes.
future_pipeline.registry: Separate temporary calibration and final galleries, never ASF baseline.

threshold_design.objective: Maximize 0.5*(known correct accepts / planned known queries + unknown correct rejects / planned unknown queries), calibration only.
threshold_design.candidates: {-1,1} plus calibration top1 scores plus nextafter(score,+infinity) within [-1,1]; grouped ties.
threshold_design.freeze: Exact float.hex threshold + profile SHA + manifest SHA + objective/denominators before final inference.
alternatives: Prespecified empirical FPIR cap then maximize TPIR; sparse evidence with 15 unknown queries.
Pairwise EER only as secondary verification summary, not identification objective.
threshold_design.gates: Complete gallery and at least one valid known and unknown calibration query, otherwise NOT_ESTIMABLE.

uncertainty.final_unknown_resolution: 1/20=5pp if all valid; 4 identity clusters only.

checks.name: all raw readable RGB uint8 480x640 JPEG
two exact duplicate groups are fixture copies
pixel duplicate groups match byte duplicate groups
two ASF-failed JPEGs retained as final unknown
